en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a European city in the mid‑20th century. A tram marked with the number 2 runs along a busy avenue lined with multistory buildings, awnings, shopfronts, and pedestrians. Several 1930s–1940s style cars are on the road. In the background stands a large cylindrical brick water tower with decorative columns and a conical roof. On the right side of the image a vertical shop sign reads "SALAMANDER." The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of old postcards.
